hypothesis.H1_primary: On the f5=require (ribbon BULL-stacked at entry) bull subclass, block_elite_bull's refused cohort (tier=ELITE, level_reclaim trigger, Safe VIX band [0,25) -- the exact production gate condition) is net-positive: the gate is costing money on exactly the subclass with the strongest structure.
hypothesis.falsification: H1 is falsified for a given cell if total_pnl <= 0, OR if positive but fails enough of the gates below to not clear UNDERPOWERED/evidence status.
hypothesis.scope_lock: block_elite_bull ONLY (Safe side). block_bull_1100_1200 (gate_order #5, a different gate) is explicitly OUT OF SCOPE -- the task and WEEKEND-TWELVE line 88 name block_elite_bull specifically; conflating two gates in one BH-FDR family would blur both. Bold is OUT OF SCOPE (already disarmed 2026-08-01 for its own lift-gate trial with its own kill criterion, aggressive/params.json block_elite_bull=false, gate-registry.json 'trial' block) -- this study feeds SAFE'S forward re-eval only.

f5_classification.definition: Ribbon BULL-stacked at the trade's entry_time_et: lib.ribbon.compute_ribbon(spy_close_series)['stack'] == 'BULL' (fast EMA > pivot EMA > slow EMA, strict ordering), backward merge_asof (direction='backward', no look-ahead) onto entry_time_et. IDENTICAL method/threshold to shelf_hold_reclaim_study.py's f5_bull (WS5 line ~288), so this study's f5=require cell is directly comparable to WS5's.

modes_reported.drop: comparison baseline -- no f5 filter (the gate's FULL refused cohort, unfiltered; equivalent to the original bull_gate_atm_ssb_requalification.py method extended to the new windows)

f5_classification.modes_not_reported: f5=htf (15m-stack-not-BEAR) is WS5's third mode; skipped here -- out of scope (the task's hypothesis is specifically about f5=require, and WS5 already published the 3-way dose-response for its own geometry population; re-deriving htf for this population is not needed to answer the block_elite_bull question).

cell_A_full_391.frame: et-v2 (lib/et_frame.py parse_timestamp_et, frame='et-v2') -- DST-correct, matches WS5/WS6's 'VERIFIED 391-day population' convention. wall-v1 (this lineage's own 07-22 default) is NOT used here because the window crosses two winters (~129/391 days EST) and f5 classification must be frame-consistent with the entry detection (mixing wall-v1 entries against an et-v2 ribbon series is the exact violation lib/et_frame.py's docstring bans).
cell_A_full_391.data: backtest/data/spy_5m_2025-01-01_2026-07-22.csv (OLD) + strictly-after-07-22 tail of backtest/data/spy_5m_2026-05-19_2026-07-31.csv (NEW), same merge as shelf_hold_reclaim_study.load_merged(). VIX: same construction from the vix_5m siblings.
cell_A_full_391.method: Method A -- backtest simulation. run_backtest(use_real_fills=True) twice: BASE (block_elite_bull=True, production) and UNBLOCK_ELITE (block_elite_bull=False), current ATM strike (strike_offset=0) + current Safe gate stack + current exit shape (strategies.RIBBON_RIDE.exit.to_dict(), asserted byte-identical to the live registry at run time) held fixed across the whole window (this repo's established full-window-study convention per engine_fullhist_replay.py's own disclosure -- NOT a compounding account curve). Added cohort = trades in UNBLOCK_ELITE not in BASE, side=='C' (added_bull_cohort(), reused verbatim from the 07-22 script).
cell_A_full_391.level_detection_disclosure: run_backtest's ELITE/level_reclaim trigger detection sources levels from lib.levels._detect_from_history (backtest-native, retro-computed per-day from the SPY price history itself, cached per LevelSet) -- NOT from the live refresh_levels_intraday.py / key-levels.json pipeline that carried the IEX-premarket / SIP bug (fixed 2026-07-27 evening, commit 7b4aa3f4). This means cell_A tests whether the f5=require structure GENERALIZES across the full production-parity backtest history using a level-detection path that was NEVER subject to the live-feed bug -- it is a structural/durability test, not a direct test of 'under the corrected feed.' That direct test is cell_B below. Disclosed up front so cell_A's result is not mis-sold as validating the live-feed fix.

cell_B_post_fix_era.method: Method B -- reuse the ALREADY-MINED, ALREADY-COMMITTED decision-log cohort from analysis/recommendations/elite-bull-requal-2026-07-31.json (cohorts.safe_per_event_qty3 / safe_per_event_qty10, n=10 events each, mined from automation/state/core-decisions.jsonl action==SKIP_ELITE_BULL_LEVEL_RECLAIM, E1/E2/E3/F1 dedupe/exclusion ladder already applied, replayed through the SAME walk_exit_manager + RIBBON_RIDE CONTROL shape). This IS a genuine 'under the corrected feed' population: these are real engine refusals logged live during the levels-compiler-v2 era, not a backtest re-simulation. f5 is computed post-hoc on each of the 10 trades' logged entry_ts_et/strike against the same et-v2 SPY close series (no re-mining, no re-walk of the exit -- only the classification label is new).
cell_B_post_fix_era.honesty_clause: n WILL be small (4 sessions, 10 pre-f5-filter events; f5=require will likely shrink this further). Reported regardless of size; below N_FLOOR is UNDERPOWERED, not a verdict, per the gates below.

gates.g1_positive_aggregate: total_pnl > 0 on the cell's f5=require trades
gates.g2_day_majority: of the DAYS containing >=1 f5=require trade, a majority are net-positive (win_days > days/2) -- shelf_hold_reclaim_study.lane_stats definition, reused verbatim
gates.g3_drop_best: total_pnl minus the single largest-winning TRADE remains positive (drop_top1 / drop_best, identical trade-level definition in BOTH reused lineages -- bull_gate_atm_ssb_requalification.drop_top1 and shelf_hold_reclaim_study.lane_stats.drop_best agree on trade-level, not day-level)
gates.g4_recent_25_first_class: recent-25-TRADING-DAY window (last 25 sessions of cell_A's population, ending 2026-07-31) total_pnl >= 0, ELEVATED to primary signal per J's standing directive (memory: 'Dynamic market: recency > aggregate, 2026-07-31' -- every armed gate needs a revalidation clock, bias toward TAKING the trade on paper). For cell_B (4-day window) recent-25 is definitionally the whole cell -- reported as N/A-collapsed, not a separate check.
gates.g5_bh_fdr: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR q=0.10 across the full reported cell family (cell_A x {require,drop} + cell_B x {require,drop}, 4 raw p-values, one-sample t-test on per-trade pnls per shelf_hold_reclaim_study.one_sample_p/bh_fdr, reused verbatim) -- reported per cell, never used alone to force a verdict (thin-n families make BH-FDR conservative almost by construction; disclosed).

n_floor.citation: OP-16's own evidence_n bar (CLAUDE.md: 'stays enabled pending honest re-eval at n>=20'), matching this exact lineage's established constant (bull_gate_atm_ssb_requalification.N_FLOOR, elite_bull_postfix_requal's shared floor, both pinned by test_n_floor_matches_op16_evidence_bar in backtest/tests/test_bull_requalification_2026_07_22.py).
n_floor.rule: n < 20 => verdict = UNDERPOWERED, not a pass/fail gate result of any kind. Both cell_B cells (n<=10 before f5 filtering) are expected to land here -- disclosed in advance, not a post-hoc excuse.

verdict_routing.rule: This study produces EVIDENCE for Safe's forward block_elite_bull re-eval trigger (gate-registry.json: 'post-fix distinct tradeable safe events >= 20 OR 10 corrected-feed sessions elapsed (2026-08-08), whichever first'). It is NOT an automatic flip. Safe's block_elite_bull stays ARMED regardless of this study's outcome -- the scheduled re-eval trigger is unchanged; this artifact feeds that trigger's evidence base (evidence_artifact list appended in automation/state/gate-registry.json).
verdict_routing.explicit_non_actions: This study does NOT edit automation/state/params.json. It does NOT touch aggressive/params.json (Bold's trial is separate, already applied, out of scope). It does NOT change block_elite_bull's accounts_armed value for Safe.

reporting_tiers.EVIDENCE_FOR_REEVAL: cell clears n_floor AND g1 AND (g2 OR g3) AND g4 -- strengthens the case that Safe's scheduled re-eval should be accelerated or should lean toward unblocking
reporting_tiers.EVIDENCE_AGAINST: cell clears n_floor AND total_pnl <= 0 -- strengthens the case for keeping the gate
reporting_tiers.MIXED: n>=20, g1 true, but neither g2 nor g3 clears -- reported as ambiguous, feeds evidence base without a directional lean
